name: Quantum Of Solace
text: Give to the James Bond player. Flip to alter-ego form. You cannot attack or thwart. Alter-Ego Action: Discard 3 upgrades or supports you control → add an identity-specific card from your discard pile to your hand and heal 2 damage from your identity. Then remove this card from the game.

flavor: Goldfinger's plan to destroy the gold supply and control the economy is underway!
name: Golden Touch
text: Increase the resource cost to play each upgrade by 1. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme finds Auric Goldfinger and puts him into play engaged with them.

flavor: “No, Mr. Bond, I expect you to die!”
name: Auric Goldfinger
text: Forced Interrupt: When Auric Goldfinger would attack you, the enemy with the highest ATK attacks you instead. Do not give that enemy a boost card for this activation. (007's nemesis minion.)

flavor: “Once that hat leaves his hand, you're already dead.” –Goldfinger
name: Oddjob
text:
Guard. Retaliate 1.
[star] Oddjob's attacks gain piercing and ranged.

flavor: Bond's mission: keep her safe. Spectre's mission: kill them both.
name: Targeted By Spectre
text: While this scheme is in play, each enemy gets +1 ATK. When Revealed: Each player must choose to either exhaust their identity or place 2 threat here.

name: Femme Fatale
text: Treat attached ally as a minion with a blank text box (except for [[Traits]]). Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an ally. Put that ally into play engaged with you with Femme Fatale attached to it.
